phase_name: Verify against the real stale deploys and measure after

objectives.description: Dry-run replay of all 5 Phase 1 fixtures in a scratch directory
Apply ordinary resync to real deploys and measure after-state
Measure no-change control set spot check

deviations.description: Apply an ordinary load/resync to each stale deploy
deviations.reason: ModelBuilder's own .claude/ tree showed 98 uncommitted, in-progress, unrelated changes (git-tracked there, unusually) -- a concurrent restructure this dispatch has no visibility into. Applying a live resync on top of an unknown in-progress change set was judged unsafe. Demonstrated via scratch-directory replay of its real Phase 1 fixture instead (12 -> 28, fingerprint-identical, both orphans removed, survivor intact). The host repo's own live redeploy was deferred to Phase 8 (which already redeploys the host for the full gate set) rather than redeploying it twice; its Phase 6 demonstration is likewise a scratch replay of the live file (28 -> 27, fingerprint-identical).
deviations.annotation: see per-task annotations in Phase 6's checklist

notes: Logos/Theory, Logos/Website, and theorem_proving_in_lean4 were resynced for real via deploy-headless.sh --skip-verify and measured directly against the live file: all three show correct orphan removal, byte-identical env/permissions fingerprints, zero per-event duplicates, and true no-op idempotence on a second resync. See records/02_after-measurements.md for the full table and the ModelBuilder/host deferral reasoning. Two issue-record.sh entries filed (the ModelBuilder deferral as a minor scope-mismatch issue; the clean first-try end-to-end mechanism success as a win).
